text:
alex: Heads up — planning migration of DB + object storage to prod encryption (SSE-KMS) this Friday 22:00 UTC. Need sign-off on RBAC, audit hooks, and a vuln check before we flip keys.

maria: timeline? can we do a canary first?

alex: Plan outline:
- freeze schema deploys 30m prior
- take DB snapshot and copy to prod KMS CMK
- ensure snapshots and S3 objects use prod CMK (avoid double-encrypt)
- enable object-store SSE-KMS on buckets (non-destructive)
- run smoke tests, monitor, 60m rollback window

chris: For snapshot copy use `aws rds copy-db-snapshot --source-db-snapshot-identifier snap-stg --kms-key-id arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:11111:key/prod-cmk` so the snapshot is re-encrypted at copy. Also make sure the IAM role used has `kms:Encrypt` on prod-cmk.

maria: RBAC action items: create service account `infra-snapshot` with only `rds:CopyDBSnapshot`, `s3:GetObject`, `s3:PutObject`, and `kms:CreateGrant` scoped to the prod CMK. I'll open a Terraform PR for the role + key policy.

sam: vuln triage — what version is our backup agent on in prod? we patched staging last week.

jordan: Prod agents are still on v2.3.0 (staging moved to v2.3.1). v2.3.1 fixes CVE-2025-XXXX related to credential handling. We should patch prod before migration.

alex: OK — block migration until agent patch is done. Can we schedule the patch now?

devops-bot: Deploy queued: `infra/agents/upgrade-v2.3.1` to `prod` requested by @jordan — estimated 35m. CI checks: 6/6 passing.

maria: If agent patch introduces any instability, postpone the CMK rotation step. Steps 1-2 (snapshot + copy) can still be ready to run.

alex: Canary plan: run process on `canary-db` and `canary-bucket` first. Success criteria: no decryption errors, no S3 403s, latency delta < 150ms, error rate < 0.5%. If failures -> automatic rollback to old snapshot.

chris: Monitoring: add metric filter for KMS decryption failures and S3 access denied on the bucket. CloudWatch alarms -> PagerDuty P1. Sample filter: `{"detail-type": ["AWS API Call via CloudTrail"], "eventName": ["Decrypt"]}` plus CloudTrail data events for S3.

maria: Runbook updates: will add a new section "encryption-migration" with rollback commands, key policy checks, and post-migration validation checklist. Link once PR ready.

alex: Rollback commands (to be added to runbook):
```
# restore DB from the pre-migration snapshot
aws rds restore-db-instance-from-db-snapshot --db-instance-identifier restore-db --db-snapshot-identifier snap-preprod-123 
# copy snapshot using old CMK if needed
aws rds copy-db-snapshot --source-db-snapshot-identifier snap-preprod-123 --target-db-snapshot-identifier snap-restore-oldkey --kms-key-id arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:11111:key/old-cmk
# copy S3 objects back to restore bucket using old key
aws s3 cp s3://canary-bucket/encrypted/ s3://restore-bucket/ --recursive --sse aws:kms --sse-kms-key-id arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:11111:key/old-cmk
```

jordan: After canary success, propose full prod migration 4h later to allow agent patch + monitoring baseline.

sam: tagging: add `redwood:enc-migration=1836007890` to all new snapshots and copied objects for auditability.

alex: Also update CloudTrail to ensure `kms:CreateGrant`, `kms:Decrypt`, `kms:GenerateDataKey` are logged and retained 90 days for now. We'll escalate retention if compliance asks.

maria: I'll create the Terraform PR for the service account + key policy + CloudTrail config, and link the runbook update.

devops-bot: Reminder: if decryption errors > 0.5% during canary, auto-run `kms-decrypt-retry` and escalate to #eng-oncall.

alex: Great — reconvene 30m before canary. :thumbsup:
